description.value: Whistle Buoy Brewing is a tiny, experimental craft brewery producing small-batch beers in 800-litre batches from a compact production space in the lower courtyard of Victoria's historic Market Square. Their taproom and year-round patio are tucked into the Market Square courtyard — a slightly hidden gem that rewards cyclists willing to follow the signs. A food counter called Grub serves sandwiches and snacks, dogs on leashes are welcome on the patio, and kids are permitted until 9 pm.
